headline_cluster.headline: האסלאם צפוי לעקוף את הנצרות ולהפוך לדת הגדולה בעולם עד שנת 2035
headline_cluster.note: Paywalled (.premium); only lead/opening paragraphs visible via WebFetch. Attributes projection to Pew Research Center, published 2026-11-18: ~2.57B Muslims vs ~2.52B Christians by 2035; driver cited as birth rates not conversion, especially sub-Saharan Africa; photo caption cites Pew for Pakistan becoming largest Muslim population by 2070.
